certification.name: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional

domains.name: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance

tasks.name: Implement input and output safety controls.
Implement data security and privacy controls.
Implement AI governance and compliance mechanisms.

domains.name: Operational Efficiency and Optimization for Generative AI Applications

concepts.name: Filter harmful model inputs
concepts.description: Use Bedrock Guardrails or custom real-time moderation before invocation to block disallowed or dangerous user input.

concepts.name: Filter harmful model outputs
concepts.description: Apply response filtering, moderation evaluation, and deterministic post-processing where necessary before output is shown or executed.

concepts.name: Verify accuracy and reduce hallucination
concepts.description: Ground outputs with approved evidence and use fact checks, confidence/semantic checks, and structured schemas to detect unsupported or malformed responses.

concepts.name: Layer safety defenses
concepts.description: Combine preprocessing, model/Guardrail controls, post-processing validation, API filtering, and least privilege instead of relying on one safety mechanism.

concepts.name: Defend against prompt injection and jailbreaks
concepts.description: Detect, sanitize, classify, constrain, and adversarially test direct and indirect inputs that try to override instructions or misuse tools.

concepts.name: Build protected AI environments
concepts.description: Use private network paths where supported, IAM, fine-grained data access, and monitoring so model deployments and data sources are appropriately isolated.

concepts.name: Protect sensitive information and retention
concepts.description: Detect PII/sensitive data, apply Bedrock privacy and Guardrail controls, and set retention/lifecycle policies appropriate to prompts, context, outputs, and source data.

concepts.name: Mask and anonymize sensitive fields
concepts.description: Redact, mask, tokenize, or anonymize sensitive values before model use or logging when the raw value is not required.

concepts.name: Document models and data lineage
concepts.description: Use model cards, lineage, metadata, and decision logs to explain what was used, approved, and changed.

concepts.name: Audit data and API activity
concepts.description: Use Data Catalog metadata, CloudTrail, and centralized logs to establish traceability of data and service actions.

concepts.name: Map controls to compliance requirements
concepts.description: Translate organizational and regulatory requirements into technical controls, evidence, retention, access, and review processes.

concepts.name: Continuously monitor AI governance risks
concepts.description: Monitor misuse, drift, policy violations, bias indicators, and data leakage; retain appropriate decision and redaction logs.

concepts.name: Provide transparency and source attribution
concepts.description: Expose uncertainty, sources, limitations, and trace information when appropriate so users understand model outputs.

concepts.name: Evaluate fairness and harmful bias
concepts.description: Use representative test sets, human review, A/B testing, LLM-as-judge where suitable, and subgroup analysis to identify unfair behavior.

concepts.name: Enforce responsible-AI controls throughout lifecycle
concepts.description: Combine model cards, Guardrails, policy checks, evaluation, and documented approvals from development through operation.
